scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.verify:json: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); console.log('PASS: package.json is valid JSON')"
scripts.verify:syntax: bash -n scripts/verify-logs.sh && echo 'PASS: verify-logs.sh syntax is valid'
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh all
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh frontend
scripts.verify:backend: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh backend
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh e2e
scripts.verify:integration: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh integration
scripts.verify:lint: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh lint
scripts.verify:build: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh build
scripts.verify:coverage: npm run verify:json && npm run verify:syntax && bash ./scripts/verify-logs.sh coverage
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:backend && npm run coverage:frontend
